description: Reverse-engineer a reference design — a screenshot, an image set, or a live URL — into a portable Design DNA JSON across three dimensions (measurable tokens, qualitative style, special-rendering effects), then generate a new self-contained artifact from that JSON. Carries the extraction rules (dominance-based colour roles, relative radius measurement, multi-reference conflict resolution), a performance-tier technology map for Canvas / WebGL / shader / scroll effects, and a delivery gate covering contrast, reduced motion, and animation-loop hygiene.
